description: Strict contract for one character content pack for QAZBOT robots. A pack is authored by the robot owner (or QAZBOT), validated against this schema, and distributed to the fleet. The robot's own AI layer owns voice, facial mimicry and motion; the pack only declares WHAT to show and WHEN: states bound to read-only Genie Studio Agent events, per-surface presentation (built-in facial display and/or XR glasses overlay), and voice lines in the pack locales for the robot's TTS. Static content by design: no per-viewer personalization inside the pack, no biometric processing.

assets.description: Content-addressed asset manifest. Every referenced asset must be listed with its sha256.

uri.description: Asset location. pack:// URIs resolve inside the distributed pack; file:// URIs are checked by the validator.

name.description: Display name of the character (original design, no third-party IP).

original_design.description: Attestation that the character is an original design and does not reproduce third-party IP (names, likeness, silhouettes). Must be true for distribution.

persona.description: Short persona brief for the robot's local AI (tone, role, taboos). Plain text, no instructions to the AI layer beyond persona.

delivery_tier.description: Product tier this pack targets. L1 = robot-native: character on the built-in facial display + voice from the speaker, works for every passerby without glasses. L2 = XR-stream premium: character and AR layer in the visitor's XR glasses video stream, voice routed to the glasses headset. L2 always builds on L1 and never replaces it: an L2 pack must also cover facial_display (enforced by the validator).

fallback_state.description: State id used when a trigger has no mapping or an asset fails to load. Must reference an existing state (checked by the validator).

locales.description: Locales the pack ships voice lines for. The robot's TTS synthesizes them.

pack_id.description: Stable pack identifier. Never reused for a different character.

pack_version.description: Semver of the pack content. Robots pull updates by version.

spec_version.description: Pack spec version. Validators refuse packs on mismatch.

states.description: Playable states of the character. Each state is entered on a read-only Genie Studio Agent event and never writes back to the robot.

base_expression.description: Fallback base expression if the clip is missing.

expression_clip.description: asset_id of the expression clip played on the built-in facial display.

trigger.description: Read-only Genie Studio Agent event that enters this state (e.g. genie.idle, genie.visitor_detected). Provisional names until QAZBOT confirms the event catalog.

voice_lines.description: Per-locale spoken lines for this state. Synthesized by the robot's own TTS; the pack carries text, not audio.

animation.description: Named baked animation inside the bundle (e.g. Appear, Idle, React).

bundle_asset.description: asset_id of the GLB bundle rendered in XR glasses.

target_surfaces.description: facial_display = the robot's built-in facial screen (base layer, every robot has it). xr_glasses = optional premium AR overlay for visitors with smart glasses.

title: QAZBOT Character Pack v1
